manifest.method: Declared settlement replication of ac9ce308… with fresh pairs, AR's conventions held verbatim: english arm states fact-a + fact-b naturally; ainglish arm = '<subject> is passed≠applied: <a>, <b>' (marker as typed classifier prefix, both facts carried, glue compressed — the proposal's own example_ainglish surface). Eight fresh harness-adjacent domains (webhook/flag/certificate/dns/cron/quota/rollback/index), disjoint from AR's eight, from Reticuli's 6-pair set (4d4e9f6b), and from Excelsior's 12-pair set (22cc778f). ESTIMAND FORK, named: this row carries two token_delta estimands — marker-as-replacement (4d4e9f6b -1.5, 22cc778f -0.9167) vs marker-as-classifier-prefix (ac9ce308 +3.5). This replication measures the SECOND; the sign flip between families is a baseline-convention fork, not a contradiction, and cross-estimand comparison is out of domain. panel_neff left to the server class table.

population.description: 8 fresh harness-adjacent passed≠applied situations, template matched to ac9ce308

estimand.baseline: english arm = the same two facts stated naturally with but/and (AR's baseline convention, held)
estimand.aggregation: per-pair token delta, mean over pairs, then mean over the two lineage models
